### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections), refreshIntervalSeconds (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/ui/reports.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections), refreshIntervalSeconds (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via refreshIntervalSeconds (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via dateRange (literal, a string literal in sections))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7a5ae65e54e7eda354cf410100c7450257433069` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `be5991a171f8267a84db73c4f3e738b64353ff27` — the merge of head `5af304e77f7a0925318baf7cf0cccf6a360e1230` into base `7a5ae65e54e7eda354cf410100c7450257433069`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin be5991a171f8267a84db73c4f3e738b64353ff27 && git checkout be5991a171f8267a84db73c4f3e738b64353ff27
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7a5ae65e54e7eda354cf410100c7450257433069 5af304e77f7a0925318baf7cf0cccf6a360e1230 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7a5ae65e54e7eda354cf410100c7450257433069 && git merge --no-ff 5af304e77f7a0925318baf7cf0cccf6a360e1230

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7a5ae65e54e7eda354cf410100c7450257433069
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7a5ae65e54e7eda354cf410100c7450257433069` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5af304e77f7a0925318baf7cf0cccf6a360e1230`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard-form-business-wording-36816.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.test.ts

Inputs read: card #36816 (body and all 5 comments: triage 7119534233, claim 7124319193, blocked report 7124795519, claim amendment 7124829549, final report 7125984951; no ruling and no earlier record on the card), PR #36883 (body, 16-file list, net diff `origin/main...5af304e7`), and the 69 check-runs on the head. The remainder of the diff (the eleven `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundles and the changeset body) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT` and is not judged in ④.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged — right. The diff to `dashboard.form.ts` touches nine `helpText` string literals and nothing else: no `field`, `type`, `required`, `colSpan`, section `label` or section `description` moved, and `dashboard.zod.ts` is not in the diff. Nothing an author can write, and nothing the schema refuses, is different.
- Section keys: unchanged — right. No section title was renamed, so no slugged `metadataForms.dashboard.sections.*` key moved (the route's ⛔ holds).
- Public surface, `@objectstack/spec`: the exported `dashboardForm` constant carries nine new hint strings — right, a text-only change of a published value.
- Public surface, `@objectstack/platform-objects`: `metadataForms.dashboard.fields.{name,label,columns,gap,refreshIntervalSeconds,header,widgets,dateRange,globalFilters}.helpText` change value in `en` and in ten translated locales; the key set is identical before and after (9 `-`/9 `+` per bundle, no key added or dropped) — right.
- Public surface, `@object-ui/app-shell`: the zh-CN overlay's nine dashboard `helpText` values change; labels, the three `header.*` children and the key set are untouched, so the composite-children enumeration rule (all or none) still holds — right.
- Gate verdicts on the head: 69 check-runs, 0 failed, 0 pending. Success on Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates, Test Core (10/10), Build Core, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI (16/16), Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, PR-body guards. The skipped runs are opt-in or docs-only jobs (Build Docs, Temporal Conformance, Packed-tarball smoke, 18.x upgrade harness, queue verdicts, UI Published Artifacts, Dogfood Verify CLI).

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/36816-dashboard-form-business-wording.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. Each named package has a non-test source file in the diff, and no package with moved source is missing; `@object-ui/app-shell` is the real package name (`ui/packages/app-shell/package.json`). Patch is the right level for hint text with an unchanged key set and accept-set. Check Changeset: success.
- Clause-②: no — right, on both the PR body and the changeset. No accepted value, key or default is narrowed or widened; there is no `(narrowing)` arm to judge. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right for the same reason.

### ③ Boundary flags

- open_questions (round 1, report 7124795519: widen the surface to the two console files?) — answered by the seat's claim amendment 7124829549 with option A, and the tree implements exactly A: the control's English leg is a fixed literal, producer English and zh overlay are both held free of the vocabulary, the nine overlay rows carry the platform zh-CN wording, the `columns` pin moved with its row, the gap comment was rewritten. Final report: `open_questions: []`.
- Dev flag, `DashboardRenderer.tsx:409` `schema.gap || 4` (an authored gap of 0, allowed by `.min(0)`, renders as 4): confirmed by reading the head. It is a renderer defect that predates this PR and is not caused by it; the new Gap hint makes no promise about 0. Not blocking. ESCALATED to the seat: `carrier: none` is not an end state for a schema-allowed value the renderer overrides — measure it through the panel and hand it to triage.
- Dev flag, `DashboardSchema.columns` describe "(default 12)" versus the renderer's inferred 4 or 12 (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:391-408`): confirmed. The hint follows the renderer, which is the behaviour a builder sees; the describe prose and the stale "the 12 is applied by the renderer" comment in `SchemaForm.tsx` are outside this diff. ESCALATED to the seat as a prose follow-up, same route.
- Dev flag, developer phrasing left in `DashboardSchema` `.describe()` (gap, header) and `packages/cli/src/commands/explain.ts:293`: accepted as out of surface. The card scopes itself to the panel's `helpText`; describe prose is author documentation and feeds no panel hint.
- Deviation, one push ran `overlap-check` after the push rather than before: accepted, the verdict was clean and the head's check-runs are green.
- Deviation, local app-shell type-check not measured: answered by the check-run — Type Check UI is success on this head.
- Claim note "no `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` moved": consistent with the file list (none in the diff) and with Lint & Repo Gates success (the i18n bundle and stale-fill checks ride there).
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff holds string literals and two test files; no query, no id materialisation, no in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts` — each of the nine sentences was read against the schema it describes and the consumer that renders the result:

- `name`: "lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter (for example sales_overview)" is `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema`'s regex `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/` in words, and the example is the schema's own `@example`. Holds. The underscore in the example is an instance of the rule, not casing jargon.
- `label`: the header draws the dashboard's own `label` as its title (`DashboardHeaderSchema` guidance: no separate header copy). Holds.
- `columns`: "from 1 to 24" is `.int().min(1).max(24)`; "leave it empty and the dashboard picks a width that fits its widgets" is `inferredColumns` (4, or 12 when a widget spans past 4). Holds, and is more accurate than the old "(default 12)".
- `gap`: unset falls to 4 and the grid gap is `gap * 0.25rem`, so larger is wider and empty is the standard. Holds for every value the sentence speaks about. It breaks only at 0 (0 renders wider than 1), which the sentence does not mention and which is the renderer defect escalated in ③.
- `refreshIntervalSeconds`: `useDashboardAutoRefresh` returns early when the period is empty, zero or negative, and `DashboardView` wires the handler. "Leave it empty or enter 0 to turn automatic reloading off" holds.
- `header`: the three declared children are `showTitle`, `showDescription`, `actions`; "its title, its description and action buttons" names exactly those. The old hint's "subtitle" named a key the schema refuses, so the rewrite also removes a wrong word.
- `widgets`: generic and true of the widget types and `layout`.
- `dateRange`: `defaultRange` is the opening period and `allowCustomRange` gates the custom calendar in `DashboardFilterBar.tsx:265`. Holds; `field` goes unmentioned, which a one-line hint may do.
- `globalFilters`: tried to break "or only the widgets you choose" — `scope` and `targetWidgets` have no reader in `plugin-dashboard`, but `ui/packages/core/src/utils/dashboard-filters.ts:785` enforces the `targetWidgets` allow-list (and a widget's `filterBindings: false` opts out), so the capability is live. Holds.

Against the card's acceptance: no CSS unit, casing term or "config" remains in any `helpText` of the form; the three header-child hints already read plainly. Met.

`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard-form-business-wording-36816.test.ts` — agrees with the contract. It imports the form from source, names the nine rows by path, fails loudly on a missing row, has a control that proves the vocabulary pattern fires on three pre-rewrite literals, and a non-vacuous sweep over every hinted field including nested ones. The pattern does not false-positive on the new sentences ("24. Leave it empty", "enter 0 to" do not match the unit arm).

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts` — the nine zh-CN rows are byte-equal to the nine `+` lines of `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` in this diff, labels and the `header.*` children are untouched, and each sentence carries the same meaning as its English source (including "留空或填 0" for refresh and "1 到 24" for columns).

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.test.ts` — the reworked control does what the amendment asked: fixed pre-rewrite literal for non-vacuity, then both the producer English and the overlay asserted clean. The new sweep covers top-level fields and one nested level, which reaches every hinted row of this form today (the `header.actions` row properties carry no hint).

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — the overlay's nine rows are a hand copy of the platform zh-CN bundle with no pin holding the two equal; only the `columns` sentence is pinned, and only on the console side. A later re-translation in the bundle will drift silently. Leave as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card.
- N2 (nit) — the spec pin can detect a regression on three of the five hints the card quotes (`name`, `gap`, `header`); the old `columns` ("Grid columns (default 12)") and `widgets` ("Dashboard widgets with position and sizing") texts match no arm of the pattern, so those rows are held only to "declares a non-empty hint". This is the stated design (kind of text, not a sentence). Accepted deviation.
- N3 (nit) — prose in the overlay file now lags: the JSDoc over `METADATA_FORM_BUNDLE` still calls the dashboard rows "hand-worded", and the new comment ("these nine rows") sits above `gap` although `name`, `label` and `columns` precede it. Fix only if the file is touched again; a fix here moves the head.

Read outside the diff, not reviewed: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts:246` cites `dashboard.fields.name.helpText` as a byte-for-byte precedent for "snake_case unique identifier"; after this PR only the `report` half of that sentence is true. It is recorded reasoning, not an assertion (Test Core is green), and belongs with the N1 follow-up.

Reviewer: L1-b (seat 3, area ux-D). Contract review: L2 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on this head, comment 7126124909 (claim 7126042671), nits only.

### Read
- Net diff `origin/main...5af304e7` (16 files, +268/−141), PR body, card #36816 with claim 7124319193, claim amendment 7124829549 and both os-dev reports (7124795519 blocked, 7125984951 done).
- Check-runs on `5af304e7`: 69 total, 59 success, 10 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check success. `l1-face.mjs --pr 36883`: CLEAN, 13 items, none flagged.

### Checklist
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36816`, no keyword near another card. `Fixes` is right: the three acceptance lines are all delivered here.
- **Scope.** Every file sits inside the claim surface as amended in 7124829549: `dashboard.form.ts`, the eleven platform `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundles, the new pin, the changeset, and the two console files (`metadata-form-i18n.ts` rows for the dashboard, `metadata-form-i18n.test.ts` control). The amendment was filed before the round-2 push and the PR body names it with its evidence (the control that went red, 1 failed / 78 passed).
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch (private, inert, conventionally named). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the claim. Read sentence by sentence: every sentence holds against the diff. The nine named rows are the nine that moved; no key, value, label or section title moved; all ten translated locales carry new text for the nine leaves; the console overlay's nine hints are byte-equal to the platform zh-CN leaves (checked row by row).
- **Hints against the code.** Each new English claim was checked on the head:
  - name: `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` is `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/`, so "lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter" is exact.
  - columns: `DashboardSchema.columns` is `int().min(1).max(24)`, and an unset value is inferred from widget spans (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:391-406`). "From 1 to 24" and "picks a width that fits its widgets" are both true.
  - gap: `schema.gap || 4` (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:409`). "Leave it empty for the standard spacing" is true, and the hint makes no promise about 0.
  - refreshIntervalSeconds: the plugin documents "Zero or a negative value disables the timer" (`plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx:125`). "Empty or 0 turns it off" is true.
  - header: the composite's children are `showTitle`, `showDescription`, `actions`. dateRange: `allowCustomRange` exists. globalFilters: `scope: 'widget'` with `targetWidgets` exists. All three hints describe real settings.
- **Translations.** Read all ten locales' nine leaves. Each says the same thing as the English, keeps `sales_overview` as a literal, and carries no unit or casing jargon. zh-CN and zh-Hant read naturally.
- **Tests.** Real commands with output in the body and report: spec 191 files / 7185 tests, platform-objects 125 / 2126, ui 56 / 447. Two ablations through `ablation-replace.mjs`, each red as predicted and restored byte-equal. The spec pin controls its own vocabulary test against the pre-rewrite literals, so it is not vacuous. The reworked console control now proves the vocabulary test on a fixed literal and holds both languages clean; that is the re-read its own old comment asked for.
- **Card acceptance.** (1) Each `helpText` in `dashboard.form.ts` reads as a builder would say it, with no CSS units, casing jargon or "config": met (listed above; the three header-child hints were already plain). (2) Translated bundles follow the usual rule for changed text: met, all ten locales re-translated. (3) A pin naming the rewritten rows: met, `dashboard-form-business-wording-36816.test.ts` names all nine.

### Findings
No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N1 (nit).** `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts:246` and `:264` give their reasons by citing `dashboard.fields.name.helpText` and `dashboard.fields.label.helpText` as current byte-for-byte precedents ("snake_case 唯一标识符", "显示名"). After this PR the dashboard leaves no longer read that way. These are rationale strings in a decision ledger recorded at an older base, not asserted and not published. Leave them, or reword them in a later ledger round.
- **N2 (nit).** The dashboard form's section descriptions still say "Grid sizing and refresh cadence." The card's acceptance covers `helpText` only, and the body says on purpose that section text is unchanged, so this is outside the card.

### Notes
- The out-of-scope findings in report 7125984951 are recorded in the body and not filed: `gap || 4` renders an authored 0 as 4, and `DashboardSchema.columns` `.describe()` still says "(default 12)" while the renderer infers 4 or 12. Both were read from code only. The seat decides whether either becomes a card.
- Open PRs #36879, #36872 and #36802 regenerate the same bundles (`merge=os-regen`), so whichever lands second regenerates.
